name: Intuned

modes.label: Standard browser machine, Developer plan overage
modes.note: $0.12/compute-hour beyond the plan's included hours (intunedhq.com/pricing, 2026-09-28); metered in minutes. Machine CPU/RAM not published. Large +$0.18/h and X-Large +$0.48/h surcharges not modelled.

modes.label: Standard browser machine, Startup plan overage
modes.note: $0.1/compute-hour beyond the plan's included hours (intunedhq.com/pricing, 2026-09-28); metered in minutes. Machine CPU/RAM not published. Large +$0.15/h and X-Large +$0.40/h surcharges not modelled.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: 3 included compute hours, no overage: trial only.

plans.name: Developer
plans.note: 100 included compute hours (= $12 at $0.12/h); 25 API machines per workspace, 5 per project.

plans.name: Startup
plans.note: 500 included standard compute hours (= $50 at $0.10/h); 100 API machines per workspace, 15 per project; $40/mo AI credit (not compute).

features.ip_note: Managed proxy via intuned://auto (pool type not stated) or bring your own residential/datacenter/ISP proxy; stealth and CAPTCHA solving are experimental, platform-only, CAPTCHA solver needs headful mode; no per-GB price published.

caveats: Included standard compute 3/100/500 h; Developer excess $0.12/h, Startup $0.10/h. Large +$0.18/$0.15 per hour and XL +$0.48/$0.40. Job runs also $0.12/$0.10 beyond 100/400. API machine count is provisioned pool, not necessarily browser concurrency. Pricing and docs disagree on AI credit allowances; keep them separate from compute.
No invented browser vCPU or memory allocation: normalized 4/8 rate remains null. Proxy traffic is not necessarily equivalent to sandbox egress.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

Re-checked 2026-09-28: per-hour compute rates are published (Developer $0.12/h, Startup $0.10/h beyond 100/500 included hours), so the card now prices a Standard machine per hour; machine size is unpublished (shown as a compromise).

fleet.tiers: Workspace API-machine pool Free 5, Developer 25, Startup 100; per project/app 1/5/15 respectively. Enterprise custom.
fleet.notes: 5 is API-machine provisioning capacity, not guaranteed total standalone browser/job concurrency. 10 in a single project needs Startup; 50 in one project exceeds all public per-project limits even though Startup workspace total is 100. 300/1,000 custom.
